solution.what: Located LAC copies preserving the figures and period decipherment on C-12578.
Token-aligned period plaintext with cipher figures; retained conflicting uses and sic errors.
Fresh-image digit audit read 690 for 670? (p. 506; withdrawn 13 Nov 2026 as unsettled 670/690) and 83 for 13? (p. 511); uncertain sept-em-bre group withheld.

Compared the attestation index with the 1757 Vaudreuil numerical table (ANOM COL C11E 10, LAC e001295274; targets/vaudreuil1760/key/key274.json with overrides): none of the 243 numbers present in both has the same value. Sheet e001295276 was tried on 13 November 2026 by one of our AI agents: a second handwritten copy of the Vaudreuil table (592 of 680 cells agree with e001295274); 1 of 238 shared numbers agrees with W, no better than 200 shuffled tables.

A second AI agent that had not seen our conclusions rechecked 25 table entries on the reel images (24 confirmed, 1 unsettled) and two passages digit for digit. p. 510: 159 is clear and the sic mark stands after 139, so 'toujours' is corrected to 'une' (159 = une attested). p. 506: the group after 654 is unsettled 670/690 and withheld (690 = rt withdrawn); 318 clearly numbered groups remain.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext

credits.note: Andrew Beling, with AI agents; partial code reconstruction, transcription and qualified reading, not a ciphertext-only solution.
Anonymous period clerks: the French interlinear decipherment, copied for the Public Archives of Canada (LAC C-12578).

Collection des manuscrits du maréchal de Lévis III (1890), p. 64: Paulmy to Montcalm, 10 April 1757, sending a 'petit chiffre' for a private correspondence; whether that is code W is uncertain (W is in the ordinary dispatches and already in use in Nov 1756). Volumes I-XII searched for earlier printing of these passages, none found in the OCR.

gaps.item: Unsettled 1757 numerals, p. 506 6?0 (670 or 690) and p. 518 2?5
gaps.detail: The LAC copy is ambiguous and the readers disagree; both withheld from the key. The French originals (SHD GR A1 3457) would settle them.

gaps.item: Conflicting 1757 values, chiefly 63 over 's' where 'vivres' is usual
gaps.detail: Copy slip or enciphering slip cannot be told apart without the original key or letters; kept as an observation, not a homophone.

outcome.notes: Source-and-key contribution: documents are the complete cipher extracts of pièce 179 and the complete cipher annex 180. Clear portions of 179 and the supporting 1756-59 letters are outside the claimed scope. Code W is not the Vaudreuil table of targets/vaudreuil1760 (0 of 243 shared numbers agree).
outcome.fraction_read_source: measure_reading.py: 637/648 words of reading_fr_179.txt and reading_fr_180.txt carry no uncertainty mark (holes counted after explicit-hole conversion). Edition of the period decipherment; not cipher-group coverage and not a measure of accuracy.

validation.notes: Key evidence comes from the period clerks' interlinear decipherment: the table was built from these same cipher/plain pairs and the prose is the existing decipherment, so a held-out or shuffled-key test would not validate an independent recovery. No independent solution is claimed.
